tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi nyams len rgyun khyer dngos grub kyi rdzing bu bzhugs so// 1$0000300brgyud pa drug ldan bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs// yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha// ḍā ki chos srung dam can rgya mtsho yis// deng 'dir shis pa stsol la byin gyis rlobs/ de la 'dir rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi nyams len rgyun khyer gyi rim pa ni/ sngon 'gro gzer lnga bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs dang bcas pa song mtshams/ bla ma 'od du mer gyis zhu nas bdag la thim pa'i rkyen gyis bdag nyid skad cig dkrong bskyed kyi tshul du/ bdag nyid kyis hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas skad cig dran rdzogs su/ zhes bdag bskyed blangs nas bzlas pa la 'jug ste/ de yang brgya phrag dang po'i dmigs pa ni/ rang gi lce steng nas hūm̐ mthing ga mu tig bstar la brgyus pa ltar babs khong pa gang*/ sha khrag nang khrol sdig sgrib thams cad 'od skur dag pa la sems gtad/ brgya phrag gnyis par khong nang gi hūm̐ las hūm̐ grangs med phyir thon/ snod bcud thams cad hūm̐ gis mer gyis khengs pa la dmigs pa gtad/ brgya phrag gsum pa'i mgor hrīḥzhes brjod pas hūm̐ rnams mkha' 'gro mar gyur cing*/ kun kyang hūm̐ sgra di ri rir sgrog pa la sems gtad/ nyer gcig skabs rang gi mgrin par hūm̐ dmar po tshon gang las 'od zer 'phros mkha' 'gro rnams la phog pas/ de dag thams cad gar bsgyur zhing 'dzab dbyangs sgrog pa la brten te/ 'jig rten thams cad mer mer shig shig yom yom 'gul 'gul ldeg ldeg 'ur 'ur chem chem du gyur/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyang nam mkha' la byon te/ dbang bskur lung ston dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod shis pa brjod/ lha srin sde brgyad 'dar zhing rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus te bdag gi mdun du bka' nyan pa dang*/ snod bcud kyi tshe srog dpal 'byor 'dod rgu thams cad char bzhin du babs par bsams la/
thun bsdu khar/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin yongs rdzogs spyan 'dren gshegs:

sogs dang*/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: ma hā sarba pū dza khā hi: bstod ltar/ hūm̐: skye 'gag med pa sogs dang*/ phrin las nang ltar bstod pa bya'o// zhes pa 'di'ang rnam dkar dad stobs kyis phyug pa gang gis bskul ba'i ngor/ lam 'di'i rnal 'byor pa blo bzang pad+ma phrin las kyis pho brang chen po po ta la'i char 'dabs su sbyar ba'o/// /
